#summary Tutorial on how to prepare a model for the EMFStore


<wiki:video url="http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XgXm6LbBaKI"/> 

Links to required resources:
  * [http://help.eclipse.org/galileo/topic/org.eclipse.emf.doc/tutorials/rosepkg/library.mdl Eclipse Library Example Model]

Important Note: You must leave the "resolveProxies" property of References at its default value "true", otherwise EMFStore will not work correctly.
